create_lstm_core: create an LSTM RNN core with configurable hidden size, projection size, and forget bias
build_gru_core: build a GRU RNN core with configurable hidden size and Glorot uniform weight initialization
run_static_unroll: run a static unroll of an RNN core over a time-major input sequence with initial state
run_dynamic_unroll: run a dynamic unroll of an RNN core over a time-major input sequence with optional sequence lengths
create_conv_lstm: create a convolutional LSTM core with configurable spatial dimensions, kernel shape, and output channels
